input: What is the refund rate for products in the Electronics category?

expected_result.derivation: psql, independent of the app: SUM(order_items.quantity) for Electronics order_items with an approved refund (10) divided by SUM(order_items.quantity) for all Electronics order_items regardless of refund status (23) = 10/23 = 0.4348. Verified against the 20 raw Electronics order_item rows by hand; confirmed no order_item has more than one refund row, and no Electronics refund is denied or pending, so this definition has no edge case to argue about here.

generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_refunds, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) AS total_order_items, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' LIMIT 500
failed_checks: expected_result: no returned value within 0.01 of 0.4348 (or 43.480000000000004 as a percent)
